panels.title: Where is Greece?
points: Borders: Albania, North Macedonia, Bulgaria, Turkey

parts.text: Sea: on the coast near the Aegean

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: Athens is in south-east Europe, on the coast near the Aegean Sea, south-east of the UK

blocks.text: Label the Aegean Sea, the Ionian Sea and Mount Olympus.

blocks.answers: Aegean Sea: east of mainland Greece; Ionian Sea: west; Mount Olympus: north, near Thessaloniki.

keywords.def: the sea between Greece and Turkey
the most important city where the government is

questions.q: Which sea is between Greece and Turkey?
In which direction is Greece from the UK?
Core: Label the map of Greece: Athens, Crete, Aegean Sea, Ionian Sea, Mediterranean Sea, four neighbouring countries.
Extend: Write a location sentence for Crete.
questions.a: For example: Crete is a large island in the south of Greece in the Mediterranean Sea

questions.q: Stretch: Why might islands be hard to govern?
questions.a: They are spread out; travel takes time; services are hard to reach
B) Athens. Athens is the capital; Crete is an island; Sparta is a town.

questions.q: Big question: why might many islands be hard to govern?
questions.a: People are spread across the sea, so travel, schools and hospitals are harder to provide
